text:
viv: Heads up — traffic to legacy-model-1 spiking and we're seeing cost + latency push. I think a routing policy diff slipped in. Can someone open a rapid diversion to a maintenance corridor?

sam: On it. Which corridor name? legacy-shunt or the newer one?

viv: It's the `legacy-corridor` policy. We should divert to `degraded-fallback` and pin precedence low-risk. Quick plan: 1) add header `X-RW-DIVERT: degraded-fallback` 2) set route precedence to 95 3) monitor errors + quotas.

lex: I can trigger the admin toggle. Doing the API call now.

lex: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/policies/divert \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"policy":"legacy-corridor","divert_to":"degraded-fallback","ttl_s":900,"set_header":"X-RW-DIVERT: degraded-fallback","precedence":95}'
```

deploy-bot: policy-divert executed by lex @2187654330 — change_id=pid-8910 — schedule ttl=900s — no immediate errors.

jordan: Telemetry: route.match count for `legacy-corridor` dropped ~70% within 30s, 5xx briefly bumped to 0.6% then settled to 0.12%. End-to-end latency decreased ~28ms.

ops-bot: cost-rate alert: ingest spike earlier 12% vs baseline. After diversion cost slope flattened. Watching.

viv: Good. We'll hold diversion for 15m, validate route counts, quota consumption, and rollout UX in console. Rollback plan: clear `X-RW-DIVERT` header and restore prior precedence if we see error_rate > 1% for 3m or token-quota overshoot. If rollback needed, page oncall and run emergency-playbook.

sam: :thumbsup: I'm monitoring the console (Routes -> Policies -> legacy-corridor). Keeping window open. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/traffic-divert (internal).

lex: Quick check output from metrics API: `curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/metrics?m=route.match.count&route=legacy-corridor"` => 2845 -> 812 after toggle. Posting screenshot to thread.

viv: Thanks. Also confirm dashboard alert thresholds: quota.alert.token_usage at 80% should not trigger — if it does we rollback.

jordan: Noted. I'll keep an eye on per-route latency and per-token cost. If anything degrades, I'll flip rollback and annotate in the console notes.

deploy-bot: diversion auto-clear scheduled @2187655222 (15m). To cancel early: POST /admin/v1/policies/divert/cancel pid-8910.

ops-bot: Leaving channel open. If anyone needs manual rollback command: `POST /admin/v1/policies/clear-header {"policy":"legacy-corridor","header":"X-RW-DIVERT"}`.

viv: Perfect. Thanks all — keep messages short in here for audit. I'll add a brief incident stub in incidents later.

sam: Copy. Standing by. :eyes:
